basic_profile.bio: I am a 36-year-old international education enthusiast originally from South Korea, currently living in Canada. I have a deep interest in global education systems and often explore opportunities for international students. I work as an academic advisor at a university, guiding students through their educational journeys. In my free time, I love watching sports, especially soccer and baseball, and enjoy outdoor activities like hiking. I am single and usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Master's degree in International Education and have over a decade of experience working in academic advising and student support services. My passion for education has led me to continuously learn through online courses, webinars, and self-study materials. I am well-versed in educational policies and opportunities across various countries.
